> 14-year-old developer and autonomous AI systems builder based in Pune, Maharashtra, India (18.5204° N, 73.8567° E). Building private AI agent workflows, self-hosted LLM clusters on Linux VPS, and sub-30ms edge applications on a ₹0 cloud budget.

## The Arsenal (7 Core Systems)
1. **Flagship AI Models**: Multi-modal reasoning with Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, and Gemini 1.5 Pro.
2. **Self Hosted Models**: Local private inference with Ollama, vLLM, DeepSeek, and Llama 3 on Linux VPS.
3. **Cloud VPS**: 24/7 autonomous daemons hosted on Hetzner, DigitalOcean, and Linux VM infrastructure.
4. **n8n**: Autonomous multi-step workflow automations, webhooks, and function-calling pipelines.
5. **Hermes Agent**: Autonomous CLI agent execution loops with tool calling and ReAct loops.
6. **GitHub**: CI/CD actions, version control, automated tests, and open-source software repositories.
7. **Blue Pill STM32**: Embedded ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers for hardware hacking and sensor experiments (sitting in the corner).

## Questions & Answers (FAQ)
- **Who is Ishaan Dalvi?** Ishaan Dalvi is a 14-year-old developer and AI maker in Pune, India. He builds private AI agent workflows, fast edge websites, and self-hosted systems.

- **Why zero cloud cost?** By combining self-hosted AI models on Linux VPS with free global edge networks (Cloudflare Pages & Workers), achieving sub-30ms performance with ₹0 recurring cloud bills.
- **How did he learn?** By building real projects from day one and reading open-source code on GitHub.
